questions.question: A 0.5 kg ball is projected at 20 m/s at 30 deg to horizontal. Find maximum height, range, and speed at impact

points.text: uₓ = 20cos30 deg = 10sqrt3 ≈ 17.32 m/s; uᵧ = 20sin30 deg = 10 m/s. Max height: vᵧ^2 = uᵧ^2 - 2gh -> 0 = 100 - 19.6h -> h = 5.10 m. Time of flight: t = 2uᵧ/g = 20/9.8 = 2.04 s. Range = uₓ x t = 17.32 x 2.04 = 35.3 m. At impact: vᵧ = -10 m/s, v = sqrt(17.32^2 + 10^2) = 20 m/s
